svg.title: How Interview Studio answers a question
svg.desc: How Interview Studio answers a question: your question; search memories (3 × relevance + 0.5 × importance + 0.5 × recency); build the prompt (self-description, speech pattern, top 5 memories, rules); the model replies with JSON; the answer is shown with the 5 memories it used. The memory stream (91 memories, each with importance 0–100 and an embedding) feeds the search, and reflection (insights from related memories, in the code but not yet in the app) writes back to the memory stream. Model steps use the language model; the other steps store and score memories.
svg.text: How Interview Studio answers a question
Orchid steps use the language model. Yellow steps store and score memories.
